items.reason: Goal model and create/edit form contain all required fields.
Entries are append-only and receive timestamp-plus-random IDs, so multiple same-day records are retained.
State hydrates before rendering, uses a namespaced AsyncStorage key, persists mutations, migrates v1 and seeds only without valid stored state.
Suggestion uses remaining divided by inclusive remaining days and is editable in the prefilled check-in form.
Amount-based progress and a no-sample state exist, but the sample-day threshold counts all historical dates instead of distinct dates inside the latest seven-day window.
The backward scan treats the closest miss as the weekly rest day regardless of chronological first/second miss order and does not stop at goal.createdAt.
Today derives yellow versus red from the flawed backward rest scan; the seeded Python goal with consecutive misses is shown as a yellow first-rest state.
Top/bottom create, actionable cards, edit, confirmed delete, check-in and overdue adjust exits are wired.
Amount is editable, minutes are optional, and the prior six real dates can be backfilled.
Streak, ETA/deadline and contingency plan are shown, but the Today card does not expose an explicit completion rate.
Each goal has a progress ring, three metrics, contingency plan and ten latest removable entries.
The 14-day SVG bars omit missing minutes, but each goal renders its own single-series chart; this is not a multi-goal stacked chart.
Monday-Sunday totals, days and minutes exist, but amount comparison sums unlike units into one percentage.
Past weeks are navigable and all four notes persist on each edit.
Report output includes all four notes and comparisons, but its amount comparison inherits the mixed-unit error.
JSON export, prevalidated confirmed overwrite, valid empty arrays and legacy migration are implemented.
Example-only clearing and exact-phrase confirmed clear-all are distinct.
A three-step home-screen guide is present.
Three sample goals, contingency plans and a backfill record exist, but the intended yellow/red demo states are not reliably exercised by correct logic.
Seed has only 12 records, so the 20-record banner is not initially reachable; its CTA only switches tabs instead of directly producing export data.
The palette, hierarchy and starter cleanup are coherent, but the requested purple gradient is mostly a flat accent-soft background.
Navigation, action icons and charts are local SVG, but the modal close control is a text multiplication glyph.
Crossing a completion boundary triggers a timed falling confetti animation.
Phone bottom tabs, tablet top navigation and desktop fixed sidebar/multi-column layout are implemented.
All build, audit, artifact, launch and exact-app identity checks passed.
A real check-in changed today-summary and remained after force-stop and exact-app reopen.

diagnosis: Vertical-slice implementation fixed iteration 1's catastrophic composition failure and finished in 13:09.

The final review spent time on local implementation details but did not close high-risk requirement classes: temporal boundaries, threshold-triggered behavior, dimension-safe aggregation and exact visual semantics.
Passing generic source and launch gates did not detect incorrect domain semantics or unreachable requested demo states.
